name: École Polytechnique (Bachelor of Science, Institut Polytechnique de Paris)

deadline.intake: Bachelor admission cycle labelled 2026 on page, round 3 (round 1: 20 Oct 2026, round 2: 6 Jan 2027); start date not stated

tuition.note: page states EUR 19,600/yr for non-EU students but gives no academic year, so left null

requirement.text: Recognised secondary leaving certificate with strong maths and science, IELTS 6.5 (min 6 per skill) or equivalent, no written entrance exam; selection by file and a remote English interview; application fee EUR 105.
